post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI in Fitter, Welder, Electrician, Mechanic Motor Vehicle, Machinist, Mechanic Refrigeration & AC, Instrument Mechanic, Draughtsman (Civil), Draughtsman (Mechanical), Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, recognized by NCVT/SCVT
B.Sc. Chemistry with Physics, Mathematics or Biology
MBA (HR) / MSW / PG Diploma in Personnel Management or Personnel Management & Industrial Relations (2-year full-time)
BE/B.Tech in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronic & Communication/Instrumentation, Civil, Computer Science, IT, Fire & Safety, or Environment Protection & Safety
Diploma in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, or Electronic & Communication/Instrumentation
Class 12 passed (below graduate) + Skill Certificate in Domestic Data Entry Operator (course under 1 year, from a recognized awarding body)

qualification.details: Candidates must hold the prescribed qualification from a recognized institution; no equivalent qualification will be considered. Candidates must be registered on the applicable Apprenticeship portal (NAPS or NATS) with 100% profile completion. Only candidates who passed their final exams in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible. A First Class with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates) in the qualifying examination is required. Candidates awaiting results, or who have already undergone a job/apprenticeship elsewhere for one year or more, are not eligible.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Apprentice Important Dates
content_sections.text: The notification does not specify a separate application start date; candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply as soon as the notification is released.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Apprentice Eligibility Criteria & Qualification
content_sections.text: Candidates must hold the prescribed qualification from a recognized institution; no equivalent qualification will be considered. Candidates must be registered on the applicable Apprenticeship portal (NAPS or NATS) with 100% profile completion. Only candidates who passed their final exams in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, or 2026 are eligible. A First Class with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD candidates) in the qualifying examination is required. Candidates awaiting results, or who have already undergone a job/apprenticeship elsewhere for one year or more, are not eligible.

rows.prescribed_qualification: Matric with regular full-time 2-year ITI in Fitter, Welder, Electrician, Mechanic Motor Vehicle, Machinist, Mechanic Refrigeration & AC, Instrument Mechanic, Draughtsman (Civil), Draughtsman (Mechanical), Computer Operator and Programming Assistant, recognized by NCVT/SCVT
B.Sc. Chemistry with Physics, Mathematics or Biology
MBA (HR) / MSW / PG Diploma in Personnel Management or Personnel Management & Industrial Relations (2-year full-time)
BE/B.Tech in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronic & Communication/Instrumentation, Civil, Computer Science, IT, Fire & Safety, or Environment Protection & Safety

content_sections.heading: CPCL Apprentice Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 26 years of age as on 01.10.2026. Age relaxation will be given as per Presidential Directives on Reservation. Candidates should ensure that they meet the prescribed age limit as on the specified cut-off date. You can use our Age Calculator to check your exact age and confirm your eligibility before applying.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Apprentice Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Stipend varies by trade, ranging from Rs. 4,800 to Rs. 12,300 per month (see the Eligibility table above for trade-wise stipend). For apprentices engaged under NATS, 50% of the total stipend is paid through Direct Beneficiary Transfer (DBT) by the Government.

content_sections.heading: CPCL Apprentice Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting of candidates will be done based on a merit list prepared using the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the respective trade. No separate interview or written test is mentioned in the notification.

content_sections.heading: Documents & Registration Required
content_sections.text: Registration on the applicable Apprenticeship portal - NAPS ( apprenticeshipindia.gov.in ) for Sl. No. 1, 2, 4, 5 & 8, or NATS ( nats.education.gov.in ) for Sl. No. 3, 6 & 7. For NATS candidates, an Aadhaar-seeded, DBT-enabled bank account is required for stipend disbursal; bank seeding status can be checked via the myAadhaar portal. Complete profile with all required documents uploaded on the portal.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CPCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register on the applicable portal - NAPS or NATS, based on the trade. Log in to the respective portal using your User ID/Email ID. Search and apply for apprenticeship openings with "Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited" as the Establishment Name. Complete and update your profile by uploading all required documents. Submit the application online through the portal before the last date. No other mode of application will be accepted. For any difficulty applying through the NAPS/NATS portal, candidates may contact the HR Department, CPCL, at [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. What is CPCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a notification by Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited inviting applications for Trade, Technician and Graduate Apprentices for engagement during 2026-27 under the Apprentices Act, 1961.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: The number of vacancies is not specified in the official notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application through the NATS/NAPS portal is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by trade, ranging from 10th Pass to B.E./B.Tech and MBA (HR), as detailed in the Eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Candidates must be between 18 and 26 years of age as on 01.10.2026, with relaxation as per Presidential Directives on Reservation.

faq.question: Q6. How can I apply online?
faq.answer: Candidates must register and apply through the applicable NAPS or NATS portal, listing "Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited" as the Establishment Name.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is based on a merit list prepared from the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualification for the respective trade.

faq.question: Q8. What is the stipend/salary?
faq.answer: Stipend ranges from Rs. 4,800 to Rs. 12,300 per month depending on the trade.
